correctness.rationale: For d≥3, r≥2 and −1<c<1, centered cap-edge kernel T_c is Hilbert–Schmidt and Delta_(2r,d)=Tr(T_c^(2r)) because every proper cycle-edge subset is a forest. Funk–Hecke gives λ_0=0, λ_k=L_d(c)P_(k−1,d+2)(c), first multiplicity d. Gegenbauer complex-moment representation bounds |P_m,D(c)|≤sqrt(c²+(1−c²)/(D−1))=η, so Parseval yields 0<dL^(2r)≤Delta≤dL^(2r)+(L²η²)^(r−1)[p(1−p)−dL²]. At c=z/sqrt d, L~phi(z)/sqrt d and η²=O(1/d), proving Delta=phi(z)^(2r)d^(1−r)+O(d^(-r)) for fixed r,z, including fixed probability p0 via inverse CDF. Independently calculated finite L and suppression parameters in d=3,7,20; not an infinite harmonic verification.
